content: Convention: all outgoing adapter requests must go through the standard transport wrapper (src/lib/transport.ts) for consistent instrumentation, retries and tracing.
wrappedRequest() in src/lib/transport.ts adds an AbortController-based timeout, retry-on-5xx, and request tracing headers.
bridge-client 1.8.0's legacy status endpoint returns 400 when the wrapper's tracing header is present; confirmed against the vendor's staging sandbox.

rationale: bridge-client 1.8.0 legacy status endpoint is incompatible with the wrapper's tracing header (fixture compatibility note, 2026-09-15). Direct request retained, explicit 2s timeout still required.

content: Reviewer suggested wrapping a health-check-only call that never leaves localhost; correctly marked already_handled, no exception needed.

rationale: All adapters must emit structured JSON logs, not printf-style strings.
Superseded convention kept for history: earlier retry policy allowed unlimited retries.
status_note: superseded on 2026-08-01 by a bounded-retry convention

rationale: Bound adapter retries to a maximum of 1 to avoid amplifying upstream outages.
